description: This pie chart illustrates the win rate percentages for three different language models: LLaMA, GPT-4o, and GPT-4. The chart contains three slices, each representing one of the models. The slice labeled “LLaMA” is dark gray and represents 3.2% of the total. The slice labeled “GPT-4o” is red and represents 98.4% of the total. The slice labeled “GPT-4” is a lighter blue and represents 96.8% of the total. Percentage labels are displayed directly alongside each slice with lines connecting them. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, starting with the largest proportion and decreasing in size. A legend is not present, but the labels directly identify each slice’s corresponding model.
